# KeepThread

> KeepThread is a 100% local Chrome & Microsoft Edge extension that exports and incrementally syncs conversations from 8 AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini & AI Studio, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, Kimi, and GLM) directly into your local Obsidian Vault and clean Markdown—without cloud servers, duplicate files, or overwriting handwritten notes.

Publisher: Hangzhou Jianlan Zhiwei Technology Co., Ltd.
Website: https://keepthread.jianlanzhiwei.com/
Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mgoimbdbkbfkkobhbbfflmhjklfppkaf
Microsoft Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/egenkjkggankklhmildnhiccfgjepani
Support: support@jianlanzhiwei.com
Latest Release: v1.4.0 (8 AI platforms, submitting to Chrome Web Store & Microsoft Edge Add-ons)

## Key Facts
- **8-in-1 AI Platform Support (`v1.4.0`):**
  - **ChatGPT** (`chatgpt.com`, `chat.openai.com` — supports modern & classic mixed DOM turns, code cards, KaTeX, GFM tables, citations & attachments)
  - **Claude** (`claude.ai`, `www.claude.ai` — isolates Extended Thinking into collapsible callouts, preserves button-wrapped & multi-span Artifact titles, turn-scoped web-search citations, clickable images & attachments)
  - **Google Gemini & AI Studio** (`gemini.google.com`, `aistudio.google.com` + Google AI Mode `udm=50` — Deep Research & Thinking panels, strips hidden screen-reader labels, inline citations & `## Sources`, share links & attachments)
  - **Perplexity** (`perplexity.ai`, `www.perplexity.ai` — `/session/` and `/search/`, converts inline citation pills into turn-scoped Markdown footnotes and `## Sources`)
  - **DeepSeek** (`chat.deepseek.com` — converts DeepSeek-R1 reasoning blocks into Obsidian collapsible callouts `> [!note]- Thinking Process`, preserves search citations, `/share/` links & attachments)
  - **Grok** (`grok.com`, `www.grok.com` — user/assistant turns, code cards, reasoning callouts, citations & `## Sources`, percent-encoded `/share/` links & KaTeX)
  - **Kimi** (`kimi.com`, `www.kimi.com`, `kimi.moonshot.cn` — merges split sticky-header tables, converts `.rag-tag` citations to footnotes, separates `.process-flow` reasoning & images)
  - **GLM** (`chatglm.cn`, `www.chatglm.cn`, `bigmodel.cn`, `www.bigmodel.cn`, `chat.z.ai`, `zchat.z.ai` — strips code line-number gutters, preserves `<eq>`/`<eqn>` KaTeX, separates `.chat-web-think` reasoning & distinct BigModel Trial Center sessions)
- **Lossless In-Place Obsidian Vault Sync & Multi-Vault Isolation:** Connects directly to your local Obsidian Vault folder via the browser File System Access API (`showDirectoryPicker`), serializes concurrent writes, and updates the exact same `.md` file in-place by `conversation_id`—eliminating duplicate `(1).md` files while preserving handwritten notes (`<!-- keepthread:notes:start/end -->` and trailing notes), custom YAML properties (`status`, `project`, `aliases`), `#tags`, and `[[backlinks]]`. Disambiguates same-named Vault folders on backup migration by on-disk YAML metadata.
- **Cherry-Pick Only, Per-Export Thinking Toggle & Needs Sync Filter (`v1.4.0`):** Select `All`, `Answers Only`, `Last 2`, individual checkboxes, or 1-click `Only` for a single turn; temporarily toggle `Thinking: On/Off` per export in Popup or Vault without altering global settings; filter your local archive by `Needs Sync` (unsynced or newly updated threads); and get automatic safe-length clipboard fallback when an `obsidian://` URI exceeds 16 KB.
- **Anti-Truncation Auto-Scroll Capture & Code-Immune Formatting (`v1.4.0`):** Built-in Auto-Scroll Full Capture (up to 1,000 steps / 90s per run) recovers off-screen turns on virtualized long chats, aborts safely on mid-scroll SPA chat switches, and blocks shorter or equal-length shifted scroll windows from overwriting earlier turns. CommonMark-aware code-block protection keeps KaTeX/LaTeX cleanup, Mermaid recovery, footnote remapping, and image localization strictly outside fenced and inline code spans.
- **Multi-Select Batch Sync, Full Obsidian ZIP & Local JSON Backup:** Select multiple conversations from the local archive for one-click batch sync into your Vault, export a complete Obsidian-ready ZIP archive (case-safe filenames, localized images, `.base` dashboard, and scope preservation), and back up or restore your entire local KeepThread IndexedDB archive via portable JSON files.
- **Obsidian Bases (`.base`) Dashboard & Offline Cross-AI Search:** Auto-maintains `AI-Chats/AI-Chats.base` (Obsidian 1.9+ native database view, supporting dynamic `{platform}` folders) and `AI-Chats/_AI-Chats-Index.md` MOC without overwriting handwritten index files. Provides `Cmd+Shift+K` / `Ctrl+Shift+K` 100% local IndexedDB search across all 8 platforms, a draggable corner-snap status pill (`Synced ✓` / `+N new · Update`), and 1-click **Copy Context Prompt** to carry research between AI tools.
- **Verifiable Zero-Cloud Privacy:** No backend server stores your prompts and no `<all_urls>` permission is requested. Outbound requests occur only when downloading referenced conversation images from their original hosts into your local Vault (when local image archiving is enabled) or when voluntarily activating/verifying an optional Pro license key via Dodo Payments.

## Pricing (Anti-Subscription, One-Time Pro)
- **Free Forever ($0, no account required):** Unlimited single-thread clean Markdown downloads & clipboard copies across all 8 AI platforms, custom speaker headings, Full Capture, per-export Thinking toggle, 5 free direct in-place Obsidian Vault syncs, and a 20-thread local offline search archive.
- **Lifetime Pro ($19 one-time Early Bird via Dodo Payments):** Unlimited in-place Obsidian Vault syncs, unlimited local offline cross-platform search (`Cmd+Shift+K`), multi-select Batch Sync to Vault & full Obsidian ZIP export, portable local JSON archive backup/restore, custom folder path, filename & YAML frontmatter templates, and up to 3 device activations that never expire.
